title: The morning hours
dek: five prayer altars, thirty midjourney pieces, one southern california morning
body:
Five new altars stand at /prayer-altars, named for the canonical morning hours — matins in the dark, lauds at first light, prime under the marine layer, terce as the swell rises, sext at full-block noon.

Each station holds six pieces from Mike's Midjourney session of this morning — morning ocean, southern california summer, block glitch — thirty images turning on a slow crossfade inside brass frames. Each hour has its own synthesized tone: vigil drone, rising bloom, breath wash, tide surge, noon triad.

Tap PRAY. The tone sounds, the candle flares, the image turns, the count rises for everyone watching. Counts are perpetual — the hours are the hours.

Sibling to the Noun tribute shrine at /drum-altars. Peace be with you.
